prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1055; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any statements, requests for recorded statements, or settlement proposals should be routed through this firm.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any other policies that may provide coverage for this loss. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, telematics records, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and all correspondence. Failure to preserve such materials may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
